goal: Design a surgical way to extract, per scheme operation, a normalized list of touched/intended paths (id, absPath, relToParent, relToDb, relToWorkingDir, WorkingDir->relToDb) mappable back to the request protobuf, available before/at end of Propose for accepted and rejected operations.

stages.title: Dynamic oracle experiment (instrument TPath, run uts, revert)
Fix measured table bugs (8) + D6/D7 + layer-2 cleanups; tests 21->32

scope_decisions: Product = static request-level extraction + per-part derived-proto extraction + post-Propose TTxState harvest for Implicit entries (level 1); full cascaded subtree (level 2) is measured and reported as gaps, not built.
No edits to flat_scheme_op.proto in the prototype; no edits to any Propose() implementation or TPath call site.
Footprint is in-memory on TOperation only; nothing persisted.
open_questions_for_colleague: Is per-part mapping (derived proto field + originating transaction index) acceptable as 'map back to the original protobuf'?
For rejected proposals, is nearest-existing-ancestor id + intended leaf sufficient?
Should runtime-derived Backup*/IndexBuild paths be reported as Implicit after Propose or omitted?
result_summary: H2 per-part hook in ProcessOperationParts + schemeshard_path_footprint.{h,cpp}: 23 added lines in 3 existing files, 0 deleted, unchanged across all fix rounds. Cross-validation against the S3 dynamic oracle found 9 layer-1 table defects that a green unit suite did not catch; they were fixed and re-measurement closed 30 of 62 gaps with no regression in the structural classes. Root cause of the blind spot: EveryOperationTypeIsCovered asserts only a non-empty result, so an unset proto field still passes. Highest-value follow-up is a completeness test that can fail.
measurement_provenance: VERIFIED POST-FIX. All results measured against schemeshard_path_footprint.cpp md5 190f840105f9efa291bfca4c2895418c (913 lines) and ut_path_footprint.cpp md5 1048ae79992ad586b508f86ac413159f (936 lines), hash-gated before and after each run. ut_path_footprint 31 OK, ut_auditsettings 5 OK, six schemeshard suites 561 OK (same as uninstrumented main). Coverage: 430 of 462 non-noise oracle path shapes covered, 32 gaps in 3 of 67 part op types, all structural (8 implicit child, 24 runtime-derived). Pre-fix measurement (399 covered, 62 gaps, 10 op types) preserved in findings/s5-raw/coverage.v1-prefix.json.
